name: Pyrovex AI
author: pyrovex00

sections.description:
Pyrovex AI helps WooCommerce stores prepare product photos and product copy without leaving WordPress.

Product photo tools:

  • Background Removal — One-click transparent PNG backgrounds. 28 credits per image.
  • Apply Fabric / Print — Apply a fabric swatch or print pattern onto a product photo. 168 credits.
  • Clean / Edit — Safe cleanup-oriented edits for product photos. 168 credits.
  • Remove Object — Erase unwanted objects from product photos. 168 credits.
  • Upscale — Improve product image resolution. 54 credits for 2x.

WooCommerce helpers:

  • AI Descriptions — Generate product descriptions from product images.
  • Description Enhancement — Rewrite existing product descriptions without inventing unsupported claims.
  • SEO Analysis — Get practical SEO recommendations for product listings.
  • Product Editor Panel — Use the tools directly from the WooCommerce product editor sidebar.

How it works:

  1. Install the plugin and enter your Pyrovex API key in Settings.
  2. Open any WooCommerce product — the Pyrovex AI panel appears in the sidebar.
  3. Choose a product photo or content tool. Results can be applied to the product.

Credits are pay-as-you-go. No subscription required.

Why Pyrovex?

  • Focused product workflow — Background removal, fabric/print application, cleanup, upscaling, and product copy.
  • Product-focused — AI requests aim to preserve product details where supported by the API.
  • Pay per use — No monthly plugin fee.
  • Works everywhere — WooCommerce plugin plus standalone web dashboard at pyrovex.xyz.

External Services

This plugin connects to the Pyrovex API to process AI operations. When you use a feature, data is sent to Pyrovex servers for processing.

Service: Pyrovex AI API
API endpoint: https://api.pyrovex.xyz
Website: https://pyrovex.xyz
Terms of Service: https://pyrovex.xyz/terms
Privacy Policy: https://pyrovex.xyz/privacy

Data transmitted to Pyrovex servers includes:

  • Product images for background removal, fabric/print application, cleanup/edit, and upscaling.
  • Background/edit prompts you explicitly submit.
  • Product titles, descriptions, categories, attributes, and prices for description writing and SEO analysis.
  • Your API key for authentication.

No image, product, or AI request data is sent until you explicitly click a tool button.

Optional usage analytics (off by default): You can opt in to share anonymous usage data under Pyrovex AI → Settings. When enabled, the plugin additionally sends to the Pyrovex API:

  • Non-personal usage events — which tools you open, success and error counts, and the plugin, WordPress, WooCommerce, and PHP version numbers.
  • Crash reports — error messages and stack traces from the plugin’s admin screens.

This analytics data never includes product content, images, prompts, customer information, or your API key value. It is disabled until you turn it on and can be switched off again at any time.

A Pyrovex account and API key are required. Credits can be managed at https://pyrovex.xyz/dashboard/billing.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the pyrovex-ai folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Pyrovex AI → Settings and enter your API key.
  4. Open any WooCommerce product to see the Pyrovex AI tools in the sidebar.

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • WooCommerce 7.0 or higher
  • A Pyrovex account with API key
sections.faq:
Do I need a Pyrovex account?

Yes. Create a Pyrovex account to get your API key and credits.

How much does it cost?

Credits are pay-as-you-go. Current reference costs: background removal 28, upscale 2x 54, clean/edit 168, apply fabric/print 168. See pyrovex.xyz/pricing for up-to-date pricing.

Does the plugin work without WooCommerce?

The Product Photos page can be used in WordPress admin. The product sidebar panel and product-specific actions require WooCommerce.

Where is my data processed?

All AI processing happens on Pyrovex servers. See the Pyrovex Privacy Policy for details.

Can I use Pyrovex without the plugin?

Yes. Pyrovex also has a standalone web dashboard at pyrovex.xyz.
sections.changelog:
0.9.1

  • Fixed: Remove BG and Upscale on the Product Photos page silently failed to show results (job polling was never started).
  • Fixed: credit costs shown in the product editor panel now match what is actually charged.
  • Fixed: connection test now validates the API key typed in the field, so you no longer need to save before testing.
  • Improved: insufficient-credit errors now show how many credits are required and available, with a link to buy more.
  • Improved: job status polling tolerates brief network hiccups instead of reporting a failure.
  • Improved: admin pages no longer stall when the API is temporarily unreachable.
  • Improved: a setup notice now points to Settings after activation until an API key is configured.
  • Removed: non-functional “Remove All Backgrounds” button and unused “Default Image Model” setting.
  • Added optional, opt-in usage analytics and crash reporting to help improve the plugin. Off by default; no product data, images, prompts, or personal information is ever sent. Manage it under Pyrovex AI → Settings.

0.9.0

  • Beta release.
  • AI product photo workflows for WooCommerce.
  • Background removal, cleanup/editing, fabric/print application, and upscaling.
  • Product descriptions, description enhancement, and SEO analysis.
  • WooCommerce product editor integration.
  • Credit balance display and management.
